reviews.review: So many ads. All the time. Everywhere. So many. I can't watch a ten minute video without three sets of ads. 2 15 second unskippable ads in a row and then a few minutes later there's more. The ads have become so insufferable that I'd rather use other platforms. So disappointed in the devolution of YouTube. $16/month for YouTube premium is absolutely ludicrous.

It was never that good, but it wasn't that bad either, until recently. The video screen gets very dark on mobile for no reason, and clearing the cache, enabling or disabling the image thingy mode. Even changing the device's theme from light to dark doesn't fix it. the only way is by closing and reopening the app. Fix this or I'm canceling my Premium subscription. I shouldn't have to keep looking for solutions for something I pay for, and it wasn't like this in the previous version.
